title: Complete divisor linear system and its scheme of members
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-field] [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and let $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be a smooth connected curve [def-sc-curves]. For a divisor $D$ [def-sc-divisor], put $|D|=\{E\in\operatorname{Div}(C): E\geq0,\ E-D\in\operatorname{im}(\operatorname{div})\}$. Its section space is $V_D=H^0(C,\mathcal O_C(D))$, with scalars induced by $f$. A nonzero section $s$ represents $E$ when $E_P=D_P+v_P(s)$ at every closed point $P$. If $f$ is projective [def-kun-projective], its scheme of members is the projective space [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] whose homogeneous coordinates are indexed by a basis of $V_D$, with coordinate vectors interpreted as sections in that basis; thus it is the projective space of lines in $V_D$ (in the quotient convention, $\mathbf P(V_D^\vee)$). The set of section lines uses the usual projectivization of $V_D$.
